title: NPCs
summary: Every NPC in Skyhaven: where they stand, what they do, and what they sell and buy.

s.x: Skyhaven has fourteen NPCs. Between them they run every shop, the bank, enchanting, slayer quests and the whole questline. This page lists who they are, where to find them and what each one offers. For full price lists see
an NPC to talk. Most open a screen: a shop, the bank, the enchanting table or the slayer screen. They also greet you with a line.

Every NPC is on both maps with their face, name and role. Hover to read them.

are the five NPCs who each teach a trade: Tamsin (Mining), Mabel (Farming), Oswin (Foraging), Marina (Fishing) and Kestrel (Combat). Their shops are paid partly in coins and partly in the trade's own currency, and they unlock more as your level in that skill grows.
